provenance: Fresh adversarial correspondence review on 2026-11-01. Read the immutable bundle unit, required exact Rust/test selections, review policy, and listed supporting context. Independently traced error and boundary cases; did not reuse earlier positive conclusions. Rust best-practice skill and v2/AGENTS.md were consulted.
rationale: read_source rejects absolute/traversing paths and canonical paths escaping the configured root, while accepting optional .lean and nested directories. The path regression explicitly attacks both file and directory symlink escapes. select retains the full source alongside the selected text, and selected_source/highlighted escape and display the target and excerpt. Declaration-name matching is literal: tests distinguish Transfer.preserves_count from inferred enclosing-namespace qualifications. Wrong-kind, absent, duplicate, modified, attributed, indented, and unsupported mutual declarations fail rather than producing partial source. The contract is deliberately a restricted textual selector, not Lean name resolution or elaboration.
limitations: This is a source and test-body correspondence review. It does not claim that the reviewed test suite, Lean compiler, browser, or configured command profiles were executed by this reviewer. Named context inputs were consulted for the relevant helpers, fixture declarations, or presentation rules; unrelated declarations in conservative file snapshots are not asserted to have been fully reviewed.
